Step 3

Keep the same point and time; change only relative phase

Phase marks progress through a cycle. The source phase difference φ is measured in radians (one turn is 2π). Editing φ pauses and keeps the current P and time t; all traces are immediately recalculated. Arrival phase also includes propagation: δ=φ−2π(r₂−r₁)/λ. Here d=r₂−r₁ is signed. The absolute path difference used for the earlier in-phase cases cannot replace it at general φ.

P's x position (arrow keys work)
P's y position (arrow keys work)
Source phase φ/π (0–2; editing pauses)
1π rad

Predict: keep P equidistant and compare φ=0, 0.5π, π, 2π. The cycle amplitudes are 2A, √2A, 0, 2A. Then move P to either side and compare the signed propagation distance. Editing φ does not move P or advance the clock.

Phase difference φ:
φ = 0 (in-phase start)
φ = π (opposite start)
Reset Step3 & pause
▶ Play

Same P=(0, 2.50), same time t≈0s: y₁≈0.29A, y₂≈−0.28A, y₁+y₂≈0.02A. Instantaneous displacement is not cycle amplitude.

Traces are the previous two cycles of the CURRENT-parameter analytic prediction, not recorded measurements; edits redraw the whole prediction. Right-end dots show this instant. Cycle amplitude is the largest excursion, so a zero sum now does not imply zero amplitude.

Directed path difference d=0 (0λ); source phase φ=1π rad, arrival phase δ≈1π rad. Cycle amplitude B=2A|cos(δ/2)|≈0.02A.

Neither full reinforcement nor full cancellation: amplitude is between 0 and 2A. Small motion is not an always-still point.

Model: linear sinusoidal waves of the same frequency, equal received amplitudes and fixed phase difference (coherence). A=1 is normalized displacement and T=4s is a teaching setting. Spreading, attenuation, reflection and dispersion are omitted. Rings illustrate crest positions, not a fluid solution. Still points use only floating-point-scale tolerance; near cancellation remains nonzero and tiny amplitudes are not rounded to an exact zero.

Amplitude is not intensity

第 3 步

保持同一点、同一时刻，只改变相位差

相位表示振动走到一周期的哪里，相位差 φ 是两源的起步步调之差，以弧度计（一周为 2π）。拖动 φ 会暂停并保留当前 P 和时刻 t；三条曲线立即按新参数重算。两列波在 P 的到达相位差 δ，还要扣除传播路程的贡献：δ=φ−2π(r₂−r₁)/λ。这里 d=r₂−r₁ 带正负，不能把前两步同相源用的 |d| 直接搬过来。

P 的横位置 x（键盘可调）
P 的纵位置 y（键盘可调）
源相位差 φ/π（0–2；拖动会暂停）
1π rad

先预测：P 保持在等距离处，只把 φ 从 0 拖到 0.5π、π、2π，合振幅依次是 2A、√2A、0、2A。再把 P 移到左右两侧，比较带符号的传播路程。改 φ 不会换地点或推进时钟。

相位差 φ：
φ = 0（同相起步）
φ = π（反相起步）
重置第3步并暂停
▶ 播放

同一 P=(0, 2.50)，同一时刻 t≈0s：y₁≈0.29A，y₂≈−0.28A，y₁+y₂≈0.02A。瞬时位移不是周期振幅。

曲线是“当前 P 与参数”的前两个周期解析预测，不是过去的实测记录；改参会整段重画。右端圆点是此刻值。合振幅描述一整周期的最大偏离，某一时刻的和为零并不等于振幅为零。

带符号路程差 d=0（0λ）；源相位 φ=1π rad，到达相位 δ≈1π rad。周期合振幅 B=2A|cos(δ/2)|≈0.02A。

未达完全加强或完全抵消：合振幅在 0 与 2A 之间，不能把小振幅叫作始终不动。

模型：同频、到达 P 的振幅相同、相位差固定（相干）的线性简谐波。A=1 是归一化位移，T=4s 是演示设定；忽略传播衰减、反射与色散。圆纹只示意波峰位置，不是真实水面求解。静点只用浮点计算误差级容差识别；接近抵消仍会动，小振幅不会四舍五入成“严格零”。

振幅和强度不是同一个量
